en: Black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph of a large seaside hotel or sanatorium on a hillside above a small harbor and stone pier. Several small boats lie in the water beside the quay, and low buildings sit along the waterfront. The image occupies the upper left portion of the card, while the lower and right margins are filled with dense handwritten correspondence in a cursive script. At the top right, printed in red type, is the word "Crikvenica."
